\newcommand{\QualityAbstract}{Quality depends on the bit-width and the model size: GPTQ-INT8 and FP8 stay within 0.9 points of BF16 on GSM8K and MMLU, whereas 4-bit formats cost 0.6--2.8 MMLU points, most on the smallest model; still, a 14B model in AWQ-INT4 (10.1\,GB) beats the 7B model in BF16 (15.2\,GB) on both benchmarks.}
\newcommand{\QualityConclusion}{8-bit formats with good kernels preserve quality; 4-bit formats cost 0.6--2.8 MMLU points, more on smaller models, yet a larger 4-bit model still beats a smaller 16-bit one at less memory; on Qwen3-8B, however, FP8 costs as much MMLU accuracy as AWQ-INT4, so the quality ranking of formats must be measured per model.}
\newcommand{\QualityGuide}{Qwen2.5-14B in AWQ-INT4 needs 10.1\,GB of weights, less than the 15.2\,GB of Qwen2.5-7B in BF16, and scores 93.9\% vs.\ 90.8\% on GSM8K and 75.1\% vs.\ 71.4\% on MMLU (McNemar $p<0.001$ and $p<0.001$).}
\newcommand{\QualityReadme}{GPTQ-INT8 and FP8 stay within 0.9 points of BF16 on GSM8K and MMLU (LLM.int8() costs 1.1 MMLU points on 3B); 4-bit formats cost 0.6–2.8 MMLU points, most on the smallest model; Qwen2.5-14B in AWQ-INT4 (10.1 GB) beats Qwen2.5-7B in BF16 (15.2 GB) on GSM8K (93.9\% vs 90.8\%) and MMLU (75.1\% vs 71.4\%).}
\newcommand{\RecheckSentence}{Re-measuring vLLM BF16 on the 7B model after the interruption reproduced the original TPOT within 0.5\%.}
